items.prompt: What changes as the Moon goes from a crescent to a half-lit disk as seen from Earth?

parts.label: Explanation

options.label: We see more of its sunlit half.
Less of it is covered by Earth's shadow.

parts.hint: Imagine looking at a ball lit by a lamp from two different positions.
parts.feedback: Earth's shadow causes a lunar eclipse. Regular phases come from the changing viewing angle.
